summary: 28 modelled project sites; 89 distinct proposed buildings represented by 120 massing components. Public source examples, not the City-selected final inventory. Two Guildford profiles without usable plans are retained in the source archive and omitted from the public catalogue.
method: Simplified source-plan outlines aligned approximately to City application boundaries. Reported metre heights are used where available; estimated or conflicting values are disclosed per component. Both map building layers use metres without height exaggeration, on flat ground.
limitations: Public-plan demonstration massing, not an approved or survey-accurate 3D model. Footprints are approximate traces aligned to public application boundaries; terrain, facade, balconies, roof plant and exact stepped roofs are omitted. City validation and current drawings are needed before production.
